plugins.name: Spotify
plugins.description: Resolves artists to Spotify IDs with the Client Credentials flow: exchanges client id/secret for a token, then searches by artist name or ISRC (`/v1/search`) and persists only the ID. Requires the client ID and client secret of a Spotify app from the developer dashboard. Use "Test connection" to verify the credentials can obtain a token.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: Spotify Client Credentials 换取 access token
Spotify 搜索接口（按名称或 ISRC 检索艺术家）

plugins.name: Apple Music
plugins.description: Resolves artists to Apple Music catalog IDs by searching the catalog (`/v1/catalog/{storefront}/search`), so artists can link back to Apple Music. Requires a developer token (a MusicKit ES256 JWT); the storefront defaults to `us`. Use "Test connection" to verify the token and storefront before scraping.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: Apple Music 目录搜索（Bearer developer token）

plugins.name: Fanart.tv
plugins.description: Fetches artist artwork from Fanart.tv keyed by MusicBrainz ID: artist thumbnails, backgrounds, logos, banners and album covers, picking the most-liked image of each kind. Requires a project api_key from fanart.tv (free to request). Use "Test connection" to verify the api_key works.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: Fanart.tv 艺术家/专辑套图接口

plugins.name: ListenBrainz
plugins.description: Reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications to a ListenBrainz account via /1/submit-listens (single listens with listened_at, playing_now with progress), including MusicBrainz identifiers in additional_info. Needs a user token from listenbrainz.org/settings/musicbrainz; saving it validates the token against /1/validate-token. Tracks shorter than 30 seconds are skipped.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: 提交播放记录与正在播放通知

plugins.name: Last.fm
plugins.description: Enriches artists and albums from Last.fm: biographies, images and external IDs via artist.getInfo / album.getInfo, falling back to name search when no MBID is known; also reports scrobbles and now-playing notifications via track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying. An admin configures the API key and shared secret; each user connects their Last.fm account in the browser (auth.getToken / auth.getSession) without sharing a password with TMA.
plugins.author: TMA

http.reason: Last.fm 艺术家/专辑 getInfo 与 search 接口，以及 track.scrobble / track.updateNowPlaying / auth.getToken / auth.getSession 播放记录上报与网页授权
